recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not reintroduce Device.operation for FHIR-37545. If the work group wants to retire legacy unbound device-operationalstatus or device-operational-state-mode artifacts and OID entries, handle that as a separate terminology cleanup with compatibility review.
issue_request: FHIR-37545 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested updates to Device.operationalState, including renaming it to Device.operation, updating short descriptions for operation/status/statusReason/operator/mode/cycle/duration, changing duration to Duration, and renaming related terminology from operational-state/status wording to operation wording while keeping the same code sets.
initial_application: The R5 source history applied the issue through cd0f210b03fb, which adjusted Device operational-state descriptions and renamed operation terminology resources, and 2dd17b8ba4d5, which renamed Device.operationalState paths to Device.operation paths and changed bindings to device-operationstatus/device-operation-mode. Commit 689b68cc93e0 then removed old unneeded operational-state/status files.
additional_context: FHIR-36195, FHIR-36208, and FHIR-36213 created the broader Device operation/status terminology family. Later final decisions superseded the original R5 shape: FHIR-38904 removed Device.operation status/statusReason/operator content, FHIR-32565 moved Device.mode/cycle/duration out to extensions, FHIR-47323/FHIR-48924 aligned extension-pack operation names, and FHIR-47604 removed the DeviceAssociation operation backbone.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Device is active in fhir.ini, but XML parsing shows no active Device.operation, Device.operationalState, Device.mode, Device.cycle, Device.duration, or DeviceAssociation.operation elements. The surviving current operation-mode and operation-status-reason terminology already uses the operation-specific names requested by the issue.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the original Device operationalStatus/operationalState to operation backbone family refined by FHIR-37545.
Removed Device.operation status/statusReason/operator content and changed the R5 modeling path.
Moved Device.mode, Device.cycle, and Device.duration out of core Device for R6.
Created extension-pack operation mode/cycle/duration extensions after the core Device removal.
Removed the DeviceAssociation operation backbone and moved operation-status concepts into associationStatus.
Approved and reconciled current Device maintenance extension references using device-operation-* ids.
